prereq.title: Check prerequisites
prereq.cli: Install Claude Code, then check that it runs. Use the latest release, because plugin features ship often.
prereq.cliWindows: Windows PowerShell: {command}. Other options are on the setup page.
prereq.desktop: Install the Claude desktop app (<desktop>macOS and Windows</desktop>) and sign in. Plugins work in local sessions only, not in cloud or WSL sessions.
prereq.desktopCli: Step 2 needs the Claude Code CLI once. Install it from the <setup>setup page</setup>. The desktop app reads the same settings, so what you add there appears in the app.
prereq.vscode: VS Code: install the Claude Code extension from the Extensions view (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+X). See the VS Code guide.
prereq.jetbrains: JetBrains: install the Claude Code plugin and the Claude Code CLI. The plugin runs the CLI in the IDE terminal, so follow the CLI tab for the remaining steps.

verify.title: Verify
verify.cli: If you installed during this session, run /reload-plugins first. The plugin should then appear in /plugin on the Installed tab. Type / to see its skills as {skillRef}.
verify.desktop: Open + → Plugins → Manage plugins. The plugin should be listed and enabled. Type / in the prompt box to see its skills.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.intro: Common problems and how to fix them.
troubleshooting.authAnswer: Claude Code uses your own git credentials and can't show a login prompt. For HTTPS, run gh auth login and then gh auth setup-git. A GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable alone is not enough. For SSH, your key must work without a passphrase prompt. Test access with {command}.
troubleshooting.missingAnswer: Run /reload-plugins, or start a new session. Project-scope plugins and marketplaces from .claude/settings.json load only after you accept the folder's trust prompt. Load errors are listed in /plugin on the Errors tab.
troubleshooting.updateAnswer: Run {updateCommand}, then /reload-plugins. If {pluginUpdateCommand} says you're on the latest version, no new version has been released yet. Check What's New.
